name: VRM_CONTRACT_UPDATE_TPLT_B
description: This table contains the templates used in revenue contract modification.

columns.name: CONTRACT_UPDATE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Revenue contract update template identifier.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of revenue contract update template. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_CONTRACT_UPDATE_TPLT_TYPE.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ACCT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Type of action required for the accounting of a revenue contract. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_CONTRACT_ACCOUNTING_ACTION.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ALLOC_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Type of action required for the allocation of a revenue contract. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_CONTRACT_ALLOCATE_ACTION.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MOD_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Type of action required for the modification of the structure of a revenue contract. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_CONTRACT_MODIFY_ACTION.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the template is active.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: The process or user interface from which this row was created.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
